ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels to 35% low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke segments.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the center of the visible lobes, bordered by thick, low-intensity (black) bands along the superior trailing edges with mottled pixel transitions at the internal boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; right lobe trailing edge presents a sharp, high-amplitude jagged peak at the distal terminus before entering the waterline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Superior trailing edges follow a parabolic convex curve; the lower leading edges and central notch are obscured by water and spray.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced, irregular structural mass or protrusion at the distal tip of the right lobe, appearing as a cluster of high-texture pixels distinct from the smoother left lobe tip.
